gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.252172 34.041563)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.252172 34.041563)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.332396 47.613548)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.332396 47.613548)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p1.elev > p2.elev THEN 'Sonoratown, Los Angeles, CA'
    WHEN p2.elev > p1.elev THEN 'The Carlile Room, Seattle, WA'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS higher_poi,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

WITH
  locations AS (
    SELECT 
      '[3]' AS id,
      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-118.252172, 34.041563), 4326)::geography AS geom
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
      '[4]' AS id,
      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.332396, 47.613548), 4326)::geography AS geom
  ),
  elevation_values AS (
    SELECT
      l.id,
      ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(l.geom::geometry, 4326)) AS elevation
    FROM locations l
    JOIN public.dem_us r
      ON ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(l.geom::geometry, 4326), r.rast)
  )
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN e1.elevation > e2.elevation THEN '[3]'
    WHEN e1.elevation < e2.elevation THEN '[4]'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS higher_elevation,
  e1.elevation AS elevation_sonoratown,
  e2.elevation AS elevation_carlile_room
FROM elevation_values e1
JOIN elevation_values e2
  ON e1.id <> e2.id
WHERE e1.id = '[3]' AND e2.id = '[4]';
